title: Safer households
summary: Household changes now run through our servers. Join codes are 8 characters (older 6-character codes still work), owners and co-admins can generate a new code, and co-admins can remove members but not other admins. You may need to reopen the app to update.

title: Photo scan fixes
summary: Photo scans are more reliable now — faster uploads and clearer error messages when something goes wrong.

title: Drinks + install as an app
summary: New Drinks tab for AI-suggested smoothies, juices, milkshakes, and cocktails. Plus, install My Pantry Club right on your home screen.

title: Households
summary: Share your pantry, recipes, and meal plan with family members, with a live activity feed.

title: My Pantry Club launches
summary: Initial release — pantry scanning and AI recipe discovery.
